description.value:
When you mark a creature with In the Spotlight, you may empower that mark. For its duration, you gain these additional benefits:

  • Add your full Charisma modifier, rather than half, to weapon damage rolls against the marked target that don't already include it.
  • Add half your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to weapon attack rolls against the marked target that don't already include it.
  • If the marked target drops to 0 hit points, you may use your reaction to mark a new creature within 30 feet, carrying over the remaining duration of the old mark.

This benefit ends early if you're incapacitated or die. Once used, it requires a long rest before you can use it again.
